mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT S.SUBSCRIPTION_NO, S.BUSINESS_NO, S.PLAN_TYPE, S.STATUS AS SUBSCRIPTION_STATUS, S.MONTHLY_FEE, S.START_DATE, S.END_DATE, S.CREATED_AT AS SUBSCRIPTION_CREATED_AT, S.UPDATED_AT AS SUBSCRIPTION_UPDATED_AT, P.PAYMENT_NO, P.AMOUNT, P.PAYMENT_METHOD, P.STATUS AS PAYMENT_STATUS, P.TRANSACTION_ID, P.PAID_AT, P.CREATED_AT AS PAYMENT_CREATED_AT FROM BUSINESS B JOIN BUSINESS_SUBSCRIPTION S ON S.BUSINESS_NO = B.BUSINESS_NO LEFT JOIN PAYMENT P ON P.SUBSCRIPTION_NO = S.SUBSCRIPTION_NO WHERE B.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND S.PLAN_TYPE = 'PREMIUM' ORDER BY S.CREATED_AT DESC, S.SUBSCRIPTION_NO DESC, P.CREATED_AT DESC, P.PAYMENT_NO DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BUSINESS B JOIN BUSINESS_SUBSCRIPTION S ON S.BUSINESS_NO = B.BUSINESS_NO WHERE B.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND S.PLAN_TYPE = 'PREMIUM' AND S.STATUS IN ('PENDING', 'ACTIVE')
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_BUSINESS_SUBSCRIPTION.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO BUSINESS_SUBSCRIPTION ( SUBSCRIPTION_NO, BUSINESS_NO, PLAN_TYPE, STATUS, MONTHLY_FEE, START_DATE, END_DATE, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{subscriptionNo}, #{businessNo}, #{planType}, #{subscriptionStatus}, #{monthlyFee}, NULL, NULL, SYSDATE, NULL )

INSERT INTO PAYMENT ( PAYMENT_NO, SUBSCRIPTION_NO, AMOUNT, PAYMENT_METHOD, STATUS, TRANSACTION_ID, PAID_AT, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_PAYMENT.NEXTVAL, #{subscriptionNo}, #{amount}, #{paymentMethod}, #{paymentStatus}, NULL, NULL, SYSDATE )
